query: What deduplication rules will we apply across multiple databases and how will we identify multiple reports from the same study (trial IDs, overlapping samples, shared methods)?

response.query: What deduplication rules will we apply across multiple databases and how will we identify multiple reports from the same study (trial IDs, overlapping samples, shared methods)?
response.answer: We will use trial IDs, overlapping samples, and shared methods to identify and deduplicate reports from the same study across multiple databases. Exact match and similarity algorithms will be applied for thorough identification.
